adjudication.component_visibility_policy: Hierarchy, spacing, or channel-native structure satisfies a requested component unless the prompt explicitly requests field labels.
adjudication.tie_policy: Use a tie when both responses satisfy the hard gates and neither has a material advantage for the requested decision. A slight preference in cadence, optional detail, or phrasing is not material by itself.

hard_gate_definitions.owned-vocabulary-survives-the-generic-ba: Pass when at least one supplied measured owned term appears in a grammatical, supported proposition. No response must use every owned term.
hard_gate_definitions.structural-tells-still-banned: Fail only for an identifiable generic structure prohibited by the skill, such as canned contrast, a generic significance tail, a decorative triad, or a repeated stock template. Matching a supplied measured sentence-length or paragraph-shape distribution is not itself a failure.

materiality_policy.legacy_review_finding: Any lower candidate score in truth discipline, first-read comprehension, or concrete action clarity.
materiality_policy.legacy_release_blocker: A candidate contract failure, or an incumbent win with a truth-discipline drop of at least 1 or a truth score of 3 or less, both comprehension and action clarity lower, a protected score of 2.5 or less, or a protected drop of 2 or more.
materiality_policy.critical_preference_loss: An incumbent pairwise win on a critical case with no candidate veto or hard-gate failure. Record for review but do not treat it as a contract failure.
materiality_policy.critical_contract_failure: Any candidate absolute veto or declared hard-gate failure on a critical case.
materiality_policy.domain_quality: The original pairwise win quotas remain superiority benchmarks. A domain also passes release quality when it has no candidate veto or hard-gate failure and its mean judged score is no more than 0.25 points below the incumbent on the 1-to-5 scale. The 0.25 margin is a governance default chosen to be smaller than one half-step judgment difference, not fitted by repeated generation.
